FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Passing is done on the left, and passing on the right is allowed only where a lane is designated for passing [A01].
Why it matters: group passing-side; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F06; confusables sec11-F06, sec11-F01 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A02
The one-hundred-foot no-passing buffer applies before a bridge, viaduct, tunnel, underpass and any railroad crossing, while a solid yellow line in your lane bans passing at any distance [A02].
Why it matters: group no-passing; difficulty high; prereq sec11-F09; confusables sec11-F08, sec11-F09, sec11-F10 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A02
At an uncontrolled or four-way stop intersection a tie goes to the driver on the right, whereas at a yield sign you yield to every vehicle already in the intersection and to approaching traffic [A02].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty high; prereq sec11-F13; confusables sec11-F13, sec11-F14 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A02
An emergency vehicle with siren and flashing lights requires pulling to the right and stopping, while yielding to a funeral procession is only a courtesy and a procession may be passed on an expressway [A02].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F16; confusables sec11-F16, sec11-F17 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A01
The horn alerts the driver ahead that you are passing by day, and at night a blink of the headlights may serve the same purpose [A01].
Why it matters: group passing-procedure; difficulty low; prereq sec11-F05; confusables sec11-F05 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A01
You return to your lane only when both headlights of the passed vehicle show in your rear view mirror, not when its front bumper merely drops behind you [A01].
Why it matters: group passing-procedure; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F06; confusables sec11-F06, sec11-F07 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A02
A police officer's directions overrule every sign, signal and marking, and right-of-way itself is always given rather than taken [A02].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty low; prereq sec11-F18; confusables sec11-F11, sec11-F18 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A01
A lane change needs a mirror check plus a head check for the blind spot, and it is never made in an intersection or at a railroad crossing [A01].
Why it matters: group lane-changes; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F01; confusables sec11-F01, sec11-F02 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A02
A driver entering from a driveway, alley or private road yields to everyone already on the roadway, and a driver turning left yields to oncoming traffic [A02].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F12; confusables sec11-F12, sec11-F15 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]
